user.title: Add Cradlewise
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should reach your crib. Automatic prefers your local network and falls back to Cradlewise cloud.

reconfigure.description: Change connection mode or local address without replacing the crib or its entities. Leave the password blank to keep it. Automatic can discover a blank local address; Local only revalidates the entered broker.
